Color Doppler – When Blood Flow Tells the Real Story

A Color Doppler ultrasound is an advanced diagnostic test that helps evaluate blood flow through arteries and veins, providing valuable insights into vascular health and organ function. Unlike a standard ultrasound, Color Doppler not only shows the structure of organs but also reveals how blood is flowing in real time.

This non-invasive test plays a crucial role in diagnosing circulation problems, blood clots, vascular blockages, kidney disorders, liver diseases, and many other medical conditions. Early detection through Color Doppler can help doctors make accurate diagnoses and recommend timely treatment.

✅ Evaluates Blood Flow in Arteries & Veins
